title: Rediscovering The Kingdom Template Of Prayer Petition
paragraphs: Those of you who have a technical background will know what the model is. Those who buy a new computer usually get pre-built models. What is the model? The template is a pre-designed framework that you can use and put whatever you want inside it if you wish. In other words, a prototype is a finished product provided to you by the manufacturer that simplifies your relationship with the computer product in a way that eliminates the need to create an original design.

So, the model eliminates the need for guesswork or experimentation. This is the model. The model is a pre-designed frame created by the manufacturer, which they offer you for free, possibly with the computer, and you can use it without needing to reinvent the wheel. This is the model. There is a model in the Bible that was created by the Creator, and this model provides us with the framework within which we should pray effectively, so that you do not need to invent a way to pray.

It has already been described to you. All you have to do is put your specific requirements or needs inside the form. Is this clear? So, it is important because models eliminate the need for experimentation. The templates eliminate the need to guess what to do. The templates make it simple. In fact, models eliminate excuses for not being able to do something effectively. This is the model. Therefore, we will talk about the Kingdom's model of prayer and supplication. We will focus on the model presented by Jesus.

I call it prayer, as Jesus taught us. Jesus has eliminated your need to invent a way to pray. He has cancelled your excuses for not knowing how to pray. It destroyed any feeling of inadequacy in prayer. It makes it so easy that anyone who can understand the model can pray. Now I will tell you something about the model. It would be a nice model, but they wouldn't know what you want. They won't know what it means. They wouldn't have understood what you wanted to say. They wouldn't have known what she was asking for. If you simply use the template, we still don't know what you want. Therefore, using a template, duplicating a template, or submitting a template does not guarantee receiving a response. The next day, she sent me the cup. What will I return to you? The cup? Because I don't know what you want. This is what we do with the Jesus mold. We restored the mold for him. The procedure. This is what the template provides. The template simply gives you the procedure to use to do it correctly. Actually, this template, let me tell you something about templates. Whether you are rich or poor, fool or, black or white, yellow, brown or red, drunk, prostitute, priest, politician or alcoholic, this model can all be used by us.

A drug addict can quote from the model, and a drug dealer can quote it even better. In other words, anyone can use this model. So, the model is not the key. The key is the content. The key is the procedure. It's even the relationship. Did you get my point? Good. Let's take a look at Jesus' model of prayer. In other words, we want to learn how to pray like Jesus.

Jesus was receiving answers to all his prayers. I don't think there is any doubt about the effectiveness of Jesus' prayer. I mean, his ability to deal with problems was always successful. Whether it is dealing with illness, infertility, demonic possession, leprosy, or even addressing elements such as wind or water, or even talking to a tree. His ability to succeed in the petition is not in question. Which means that if you are smart, you will want to know how he did it. Is anyone interested?

Do you want to know what made him so successful? What did he know that made him so successful? In fact, he was so successful that his best friends decided their model was no good.
